name: @barterscoreengine/library
description: Deterministic, zero-dependency, offline-first algorithmic engine for physical commodity and essential human service barter valuation in civil collapse scenarios.
author: Erisson Marques (https://github.com/erissontech)

scripts.test: node -e "const { Validator, ItemsCore, Locales } = require('./index.js'); const r = Validator.validateDataset(ItemsCore); if (!r.is_valid) process.exit(1); for (const c of Validator.SUPPORTED_LOCALES) { const lr = Validator.validateLocale(Locales[c], ItemsCore); if (!lr.is_valid) process.exit(1); } console.log('Validator: ' + r.valid_items + '/' + r.total_items + ' items & ' + Validator.SUPPORTED_LOCALES.length + ' locales validated.');"
scripts.build: node -e "const { Validator, ItemsCore, Locales } = require('./index.js'); const r = Validator.validateDataset(ItemsCore); if (!r.is_valid) process.exit(1); for (const c of Validator.SUPPORTED_LOCALES) { const lr = Validator.validateLocale(Locales[c], ItemsCore); if (!lr.is_valid) process.exit(1); } console.log('Build OK: ' + r.valid_items + ' items & ' + Validator.SUPPORTED_LOCALES.length + ' locales.');"
scripts.lint: node -e "const { Validator, ItemsCore, Locales } = require('./index.js'); const r = Validator.validateDataset(ItemsCore); if (!r.is_valid) process.exit(1); for (const c of Validator.SUPPORTED_LOCALES) { const lr = Validator.validateLocale(Locales[c], ItemsCore); if (!lr.is_valid) process.exit(1); } console.log('Lint OK: 0 errors across ' + r.valid_items + ' items & ' + Validator.SUPPORTED_LOCALES.length + ' locales.');"
